Theorem
Source: topping:page-0083, topping:page-0084 1. ch7:2.3\group compactness-flows Let $\M _i$ be $n$-dimensional manifolds with points $p_i\in \M _i$, and let $g_i(t)$ be complete Ricci flows on $\M _i$ for $t\in (a,b)$, where $-\infty \leq a<0<b\leq \infty $. If \[ \sup _i\sup _{x\in \M _i,\, t\in (a,b)}\lvert \Rm (g_i(t))(x)\rvert <\infty \] and \[ \inf _i\inj (\M _i,g_i(0),p_i)>0, \] then a subsequence converges in the pointed flow sense to a complete Ricci flow $g(t)$ on an $n$-dimensional manifold $\M $, with a base point $p\in \M $.
